description: This file implements the MessageControl class for a plugin in the WPEFramework, handling initialization, deinitialization, message handling, and WebSocket communication.

classes.name: MessageControl
classes.description: Main class managing message control functionalities, including initialization, message handling, and WebSocket communication.

classes.name: MessageControl::Config::NetworkNode
classes.description: Configuration class for network node settings, including port and binding address.

methods.name: MessageControl::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the MessageControl plugin, setting up configurations, WebSocket exporter, and registering callbacks.

methods.name: MessageControl::Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, unregisters callbacks, releases resources, and cleans up.

methods.name: MessageControl::Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; currently returns an empty string.

methods.name: MessageControl::Attach
methods.description: Attaches a WebSocket channel for communication.

methods.name: MessageControl::Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound messages, returning command or received message.
